Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

223-5938-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.

Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Flare of Duplication copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.

When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-4659-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

3372-5400-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Synth Infiltrator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.

Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
